qa_pairs.question: If there were 10 million children aged 4 - 6 in the country in 2023, and among the parents of children who purchased dietary nutritional supplements in the past year, the proportion of those concerned about their children's vision problems is the same as the overall proportion of this age group concerned about vision problems, then approximately how many parents (in millions) are concerned about their children's vision problems? Round to the nearest whole number. Answer: xx million
qa_pairs.explanation: Among the 10 million children aged 4 - 6 in the country in 2023, the proportion of those who purchased dietary nutritional supplements in the past year is 70.6%, that is, 10 million × 70.6% = 7.06 million parents. The proportion of this age group concerned about vision problems is 61.2%. Then the number of these parents concerned about their children's vision problems is approximately 7.06 million × 61.2% ≈ 5.33 million.

qa_pairs.question: Among the people in the 18 - 65 age group who are concerned about sleep problems, if the proportion of those taking dietary nutritional supplements for the purpose of improving immunity is the same as that of the overall population, then what percentage of all adults does this group of people account for? Round to 2 decimal places. Answer: xx.xx%
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of the 18 - 65 age group concerned about sleep problems is 61.1%. The proportion of those who purchased dietary nutritional supplements in the past year is 70.6%. The proportion of those taking dietary nutritional supplements for the purpose of improving immunity is 75.7%. Then the percentage of this group of people among all adults is 61.1% × 70.6% × 75.7% ≈ 19.97%.
